statement: A byte string writing tag 42 in non-shortest form is not decoded
deviation: The only tag token the spec allows is `0xd82a`. Made it redundant into the ai=25 (extra uint16) form, and followed it with a CIDv1 byte-string payload. In gx even the shortest form `d82a` itself is forbidden (see P-2).

control.note: The form gx carries a Cid in = a tag-free 32-byte byte-string (42 §1.1, §2.1-5). No gx-canonical counterpart exists for tag 42.
